A tinkerer turned a thin‑and‑light Yoga into a makeshift AI workstation by cramming a Radeon 7900 XT into its M.2 slot.

The hack forced a DRAM swap that throttles the system, turning the setup into what the author calls the world’s stupidest desktop.

Will hobbyists keep pushing laptop limits, or stick to proper rigs for AI? 🤔
